title: Rules of War and Offers of Peace
description: Moses gives Israel rules for warfare: the priest is to encourage the people before battle, and the officers are to send home anyone who has built a new house, planted a vineyard, become engaged, or is afraid. Cities far away must first be offered peace; if they accept, their inhabitants become forced laborers, otherwise the men are killed and the women, children, and spoils taken. The cities of the peoples in the land itself are to be devoted to destruction. Fruit trees must not be cut down during a siege.
